patent.title: 一种复方降压药物组合物及其制备方法
assignees: 深圳信立泰药业股份有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E3-P1; formulation/chip patent for allisartan+amlodipine FDC. Do not conflate with use patent ZL202111334633.X.

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout E3-P1; MAH inventorship assumed internal RD.

technology.problem: 阿利沙坦酯与氨氯地平联用时相互影响，难以达到与自由联用生物等效。
technology.mechanism: 双层片或包芯片分隔两活性成分；规定增溶载体（聚维酮+交联聚维酮 15–35%）及辅料类别与用量区间（授权权利要求）。
technology.comparison_baseline: Prior allisartan+CCB compositions and mixed tablets in patent background; not independently re-benchmarked.

value_carriers.name: 复立坦® 阿利沙坦酯氨氯地平片（240mg/5mg）
value_carriers.description: MAH=assignee. NHSA PPT explicitly names ZL202111620840.4. Claims check: chip FDC + 48:1 dose + PI excipient classes match claim 1 qualitatively; solubilizer wt% not public → strong_evidence not confirmed.

gaps.description: No public E4 attributing revenue/clinical benefit specifically to this ZL vs sibling allisartan patents.
Claim 1 requires solubilizer 15–35 wt% and other wt% bands; PI lists excipient names without percentages.
needed_evidence: Full formula with wt% matching claim 1

notes: Holdout E3-P1. T0=2026-10-13. Claims check PASS (plausible) → R3; NO auto R4/R5. Formal V0.7/schema 1.0; not V0.8.
